newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria tenders to buy 52,000 T white/raw sugar.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders to buy 52,000 T white/raw sugar.

text.p: Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) on Monday issued a tender to buy 26,000 tonnes of white sugar and 26,000 of raws for October delivery, a GEZA spokesman said.
He told Reuters the tender amended GEZA's August 7 tender which requested the purchase of 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws.
He said the new amount should be delivered in two equal shipments each of 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and two others each of 13,000 tonnes of raws.
The GEZA spokesman said all other dates mentioned in the August 7 tender were unchanged. September 9 was still the final date to receive price offers and the two amounts should be shipped in October.
Results of the tender would be made on September 10.
